labels: Update installed. Close Penguin Studio and start it again to use the new version.

restarted.releaseMessage: You are using the latest available version for the selected channel.

method: The system-installed 0.3.0 application opened its real Help updater. A temporary Qt observer/controller clicked Download and install update after confirming the 0.3.1 offer. The application downloaded and verified the published Ubuntu package and invoked pkexec/apt-get itself; no external installer command or replacement updater was used. The old application was closed after success, then the installed 0.3.1 application was restarted using the same isolated profile and performed a fresh update lookup. Personal application profiles were not modified.
scope: Manual in-app update from 0.3.0 to 0.3.1 on Ubuntu 26.04.1.
Actual download, production size/SHA-256 gate, package-manager success, installed-file verification, restart and current-version UI.
Both native docks remained present after restart; live Twitch authentication was not repeated in this upgrade-only test.
Does not establish live upgrade behavior for Fedora, Flatpak or Snap.
